canonical_project: Jiaozuo Super Cloud Computing Digital Economy Industrial Park
notes: Henan Daily reported the Jiaozuo Digital Intelligence Center started construction in Oct. 2024 with full completion planned by end-2026; DVBCN's 2024 Henan key-project summary says the project includes a 1000P regional computing service center, data storage buildings, cloud application base, power supply and distribution support, and 55,000 sq m gross floor area. Electrical capacity not disclosed.
